description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceConfigurationAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Attendance Plugin's API namespace. The class provides REST API endpoints to get and update attendance configuration settings such as user permissions related to changing current time, modifying attendance, and supervisor modification rights. It includes methods for retrieving current configuration, updating settings with transaction management, and validation rules for API parameters. It maintains internal dependencies and traits for attendance services, user role management, and entity management.

classes.name: AttendanceConfigurationAPI
classes.description: API class for managing attendance configuration settings in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. Provides endpoints to retrieve and update user permission configurations related to attendance and supervision, leveraging traits for service and role management, with validation and transaction handling.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current attendance configuration settings, including permissions for user changes and supervisor modifications, returning an AttendanceConfigurationModel instance with these settings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates attendance configuration settings based on provided boolean parameters, managing database transactions and applying changes through the attendance service traits.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne API endpoint, excluding the ID parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update API, ensuring the parameters are booleans.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws a not-implemented exception, as delete functionality is not supported for this resource.
